items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - BlockStrap RCE
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, with CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap) being a critical template engine injection (CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. It also fixes CVE-2026-92909 (CVSS 9.8), an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - StyleSmuggler Zero-Day RCE
items.summary: This out-of-band security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler' by Sansec, being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This regular September bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication. These include two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and other critical issues.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1), an unauthenticated customer account takeover that allows attackers to switch a customer session to another account. This vulnerability was added to the CISA KEV catalog.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update - PolyShell Unrestricted File Upload
items.summary: This bulletin includes CVE-2026-48356 (PolyShell, CVSS 9.6), an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could lead to privilege escalation. It also addresses CVE-2026-48358 (CVSS 9.1), affecting webhooks and potentially leading to arbitrary code execution with authentication and admin privileges.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical bug (CVSS 9.1) allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Although discovered in August 2025, mass attacks were observed in October 2025, and it is still cited as a method for compromising stores in recent campaigns.
